subject: general
question: What is the rank of India in the Hurun Global Unicorn Index 2025, published by the Hurun Research Institute, which marks a significant milestone in the global startup ecosystem?
solution:
The correct answer is __**3rd**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** has secured the **3rd** position globally in the **Hurun Global Unicorn Index 2025**, published by the **Hurun Research Institute**.
 
• This ranking signifies that **India** continues to maintain its status as one of the world's premier startup ecosystems, trailing only behind the **United States** and **China**.
 
• The index defines a **unicorn** as a startup founded in the **2000s** that has a valuation of at least **$1 billion** and is not yet listed on a public exchange.
 
• According to the **2025** report, **India** possesses a total of **67** unicorns, showcasing a robust entrepreneurial environment despite global economic fluctuations.
 
• The **United States** leads the global tally with **703** unicorns, while **China** holds the second spot with **340** unicorns.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Understanding Unicorns:**
 
 
• The term **"Unicorn"** was first coined by venture capitalist **Aileen Lee** in **2013** to describe rare private startups valued at over **$1 billion**.
 
• In addition to unicorns, the **Hurun Research Institute** tracks **"Decacorns"** (startups valued over **$10 billion**) and **"Hectocorns"** (startups valued over **$100 billion**).
 
 
 
• **Geographical Distribution in India:**
 
 
• **Bengaluru** remains the **"Unicorn Capital of India"**, hosting the highest density of billion-dollar startups in the country.
 
• Other significant hubs include **Mumbai**, **Gurugram**, and **Noida**, which contribute significantly to the **National Startup Ecosystem**.
 
 
 
• **Prominent Sectors:**
 
 
• The majority of Indian unicorns are concentrated in the **Fintech**, **E-commerce**, **SaaS** (Software as a Service), and **Edtech** sectors.
 
• Notable Indian unicorns include companies like **Byju's**, **Swiggy**, **Dream11**, and **Razorpay**, although valuations vary across reporting cycles.
 
 
 
• **Global Growth Trends:**
 
 
• The **Hurun Global Unicorn Index 2025** highlights that the total number of unicorns globally has reached a record high of **1,453**.
 
• The report also identifies **"Gazelles"** (startups likely to become unicorns within three years) and **"Cheetahs"** (likely within five years), showing a strong pipeline of growth.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Impact of Funding:**
 
 
• The **Hurun Global Unicorn Index** serves as a barometer for the health of the **Venture Capital** market and investor confidence in high-growth technology firms.
 
• While **India** saw a slight decline in the total number of unicorns compared to previous peak years due to the **"funding winter,"** it has shown resilience by maintaining the **3rd** global rank.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives:**
 
 
• The **Startup India** initiative, launched in **2016**, has played a pivotal role in providing tax benefits, easier compliance, and financial support to budding entrepreneurs.
 
• The **Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)** oversees the recognition of startups, fostering an environment conducive to achieving **Unicorn** status.
